text: {"quantities":[{"id":"q1","value":2,"unit":"","kind":"count","span":"two dozen"},{"id":"q2","value":12,"unit":"","kind":"count","span":"a dozen"},{"id":"q3","value":2,"unit":"","kind":"count","span":"2/3"},{"id":"q4","value":3,"unit":"","kind":"count","span":"2/3"},{"id":"q5","value":6,"unit":"","kind":"count","span":"gifts Pedro 6 measuring spoons"}],"plan":[{"op":"mul","args":["q1","q2"],"out":"s1","note":"multiply 'two' by 12 (a dozen) to find how many measuring cups Jonathan has"},{"op":"mul","args":["s1","q3"],"out":"s2","note":"multiply the cup count by the fraction numerator (2) to begin computing 2/3 of that amount for spoons"},{"op":"div","args":["s2","q4"],"out":"s3","note":"divide by the fraction denominator (3) to complete finding the number of measuring spoons"},{"op":"add","args":["s1","s3"],"out":"s4","note":"add cups and spoons together for Jonathan's total utensils before gifting"},{"op":"sub","args":["s4","q5"],"out":"s5","note":"subtract the 6 spoons gifted to Pedro to find the remaining total utensils"}],"target":{"kind":"count","scope":"total utensils Jonathan has remaining"},"dismissed":[]}
